# Quickstart: 007-Media File Linking

**Generated by**: `/speckit.plan`  
**Branch**: `develop`  
**Date**: 2025-07-25

---

## Prerequisites

- .NET 10 SDK
- Docker (for SQL Server)
- `dotnet ef` tools: `dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef`
- EF Core design package: `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design` in `MediaHandler.Infrastructure`

---

## Step 1 — Apply the Database Migration

```bash
# From the repository root (MediaHandler.API/)

# Generate (only if not already generated)
dotnet ef migrations add AddMediaRootFolder \
  --project MediaHandler.Infrastructure \
  --startup-project MediaHandler.API

# Apply to local SQL Server
dotnet ef database update \
  --project MediaHandler.Infrastructure \
  --startup-project MediaHandler.API
```

**Expected outcome**: `Media` table gains a nullable `RootFolder` column (`nvarchar(max) NULL`). All existing rows retain their values (no data loss).

**Verify**:
```sql
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'Medias' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'RootFolder';
-- Should return: RootFolder | nvarchar | YES
```

## Step 6 — Manual API Verification

Start the API locally:
```bash
cd MediaHandler.API
dotnet run
```

### 6.1 Link a MediaFile to a Media Item

```bash
# Prerequisite: have a MediaFile with MediaId = null (from a scan)
# Substitute real GUIDs

PUT http://localhost:5000/api/v1/admin/media/{mediaId}/files/{fileId}/link
Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>

# Expected: 200 OK { "data": {}, "errors": null }
```

### 6.2 Verify RootFolder in MediaDto

```bash
GET http://localhost:5000/api/v1/media/{mediaId}
Authorization: Bearer <token>

# Expected: "rootFolder" field present in data
# If files are linked and no override: computed common parent path
# If no files: null
```

### 6.3 Set Root Folder Override

```bash
PATCH http://localhost:5000/api/v1/admin/media/{mediaId}/root-folder
Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "rootFolder": "/mnt/nas/tv/Breaking Bad" }

# Expected: 200 OK
# Follow-up GET /api/v1/media/{mediaId} → "rootFolder": "/mnt/nas/tv/Breaking Bad"
```

### 6.4 Clear Root Folder Override

```bash
PATCH http://localhost:5000/api/v1/admin/media/{mediaId}/root-folder
Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "rootFolder": null }

# Expected: 200 OK
# Follow-up GET → rootFolder reverts to computed common parent (or null if no files)
```

### 6.5 Get TV Show Completeness

```bash
GET http://localhost:5000/api/v1/media/{tvShowMediaId}/completeness
Authorization: Bearer <token>

# Expected: 200 OK, array of SeasonCompletenessDto
# Season 0 / "Specials" seasons must NOT appear
```

### 6.6 Browse Unlinked Files

```bash
GET http://localhost:5000/api/v1/admin/media/unlinked-files?page=1&pageSize=20
Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>

# Expected: 200 OK, paged list of UnlinkedFileDto
# Only files where MediaId = null
```

### 6.7 Unlink a MediaFile

```bash
DELETE http://localhost:5000/api/v1/admin/media/{mediaId}/files/{fileId}/link
Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>

# Expected: 200 OK
# Follow-up GET unlinked-files → file appears in list again
```

---

## Error Case Checklist

| Scenario | Expected Status |
|----------|----------------|
| Link file already linked to **different** media | `422` with `FILE_ALREADY_LINKED` |
| Link file already linked to **same** media | `200` (idempotent) |
| Link/Unlink with non-existent `mediaId` | `404` with `NOT_FOUND` |
| Unlink file not belonging to `mediaId` | `404` with `NOT_FOUND` |
| Completeness for a Film | `400` with `MEDIA_NOT_TV_SHOW` |
| Completeness for non-existent media | `404` with `NOT_FOUND` |
| Admin endpoints with non-admin token | `403` |
| Any endpoint without token | `401` |
| Swagger UI | `http://localhost:5000/swagger` → all 5 new/modified endpoints documented |

## Rollback

If migration needs to be reverted:
```bash
dotnet ef database update <previous-migration-name> \
  --project MediaHandler.Infrastructure \
  --startup-project MediaHandler.API

dotnet ef migrations remove \
  --project MediaHandler.Infrastructure \
  --startup-project MediaHandler.API
```
